description: This file defines extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization using System.Text.Json in the Microsoft.eShopWeb namespace.

classes.name: JsonExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for converting objects to and from JSON.

methods.name: FromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an object of type T using predefined options.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T into a JSON string using predefined options.
